feed.title: NPR Topics: Home Page Top Stories
feed.subtitle: Top stories in the U.S. and world news, politics, health, science, business, music, arts and culture. Nonprofit journalism with a mission. This is NPR.

entry.title: Cargo jet tried to abort unsteady landing before Miami crash, flight data indicates
entry.summary: Flight data suggest an Amazon cargo plane tried to abort an unsteady landing at Miami International Airport before smashing into a van and killing five people inside, according to information investigators released Tuesday.

entry.title: National Guard member arrested in DC, accused of drawing gun on fellow Guard member
entry.summary: A member of the Georgia National Guard deployed in Washington, D.C., as part of a task force to fight crime, has been arrested for pulling a gun on a fellow Guard member in an alleged dispute over regulation haircuts.

entry.title: COMIC: If we fight, is our love doomed? And other honest questions about conflict
entry.summary: Arguing with a partner or a loved one can be anxiety-inducing. Conflict resolution facilitator Priya Parker explains how to start and end a fight — while easing dread for everyone.

entry.title: Mail-in voters weigh flying to vote in person and other backup plans amid uncertainty
entry.summary: Voters and election officials are navigating uncertainty about mail-in voting for the midterms as the legal fight drags on over the U.S. Postal Service plan for President Trump's bid for restrictions.

entry.title: Citing the 'Deep State,' Trump overhauls the intelligence community
entry.summary: The catastrophic 9/11 attacks forced the intelligence community to radically revamp its ways of doing business. Now, critics say, President Trump is dismantling much of what was built since then.

entry.title: Republicans kick off a 'Trumpapalooza' of a midterm convention Wednesday in Texas
entry.summary: Republicans have never held a midterm convention before. But there's also never been a president like Donald Trump. Billed as a "Trumpapalooza," the unprecedented event kicks of in Dallas Wednesday.

entry.title: Judges may face unprecedented decisions this election. A new guide seeks to help
entry.summary: The idea of law enforcement taking possession of ballots in the middle of an active election used to be considered impossible. Now, it's a scenario voting officials — and judges — are training for.

entry.title: TSA brings back gate access for some people without plane tickets 25 years after 9/11
entry.summary: The move is a start toward reviving a tradition that largely disappeared after the Sept. 11, 2001, attacks 25 years ago this week.

entry.title: U.S. military says it destroyed 5 Iranian oil tankers after attacks on Navy warship
entry.summary: The U.S. military said it destroyed five Iranian oil tankers on Tuesday in response to the latest attacks on its warships. Iran hit American targets in Jordan.

entry.title: New report shows the economic toll of ICE raids
entry.summary: A new study shows the steep economic cost of 2025's ICE raids in Chicago. Fear kept many immigrants home, draining the area of more than $1.26 billion in lost retail, restaurant, and sales-tax revenue.
